title: A High-Performance and Flexible Accelerator for Dynamic Graph Convolutional Networks
problem: Dynamic Graph Convolutional Networks (DGCNs) require simultaneous processing of spatial (GCN) and temporal (RNN) modules with distinct computational patterns. Existing hardware platforms struggle to achieve both high performance and energy efficiency across both module types.
motivation: DGCNs are increasingly applied to dynamic graph applications like social networks, but their hybrid GCN-RNN architecture creates heterogeneous computational demands that generic accelerators handle poorly.
method: HiFlex introduces multiple homogeneous processing elements (PEs) for main computations, combined with a dynamically configurable interconnection fabric supporting point-to-point and multicast communication. A dynamic control policy partitions and allocates hardware resources based on per-layer computational requirements.
key_novelty: Flexible, dynamically configurable on-chip interconnect topology that adapts communication patterns to optimize data reuse for both spatial (GCN) and temporal (RNN) processing.
contributions: 38% reduction in execution time vs. ES-DGCN, ReaDy, and RACE
Dynamic resource allocation and partitioning strategy for heterogeneous DGCN modules
primary_theme: Flexible GCN-RNN accelerator with adaptive interconnect
